sentences.en: I don't want to leave the house.

sentences.ar: אני עושה תה ויושב על הספה.
sentences.en: I make tea and sit on the sofa.

sentences.ar: אני קורא ספר ושומע את הגשם.
sentences.en: I read a book and listen to the rain.
Afterwards I look out of the window.
The street is wet and the trees are green.
